name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  October 17, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted City Hall; Community Room # A
1St Floor on October 17, 2025 at 2:00 p.m.

Roll Call: Members Present:  Harjinder Singh- Administration
  Christine Rivera - Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson - Fire Department
  Kenrick Sanderlin - Public Works Department
  Emory Ward - Emergency Services Public/ Safety Department

  Staff Present:  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items

During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on October 09, 2025

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Otto Benedict on behalf of Market Place Productions to host a Vintage & Collectible
  Market at Hollywood Park Event at 1001 S. Stadium Dr., SoFi Stadium Lot A; Private
  Property; on Saturday, October 18, 2025 from 8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.; Saturday,
  November 15, 2025 from 8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m.; Saturday, December 20, 2025 from
  8:00 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY; Approval for 3 time event
  within SoFi Stadium parking lot. Applicant responsible for crowd control, event clean
  up, and all applicable mitigation measures. Subject to HPSP; Applicant shall staff
  this event with adequate SoFi Stadium security guards for the safety of attendees
  and employees. Adhere to all local, state and federal laws; None Code
  Enforcemnent Condtions; None additional recommendations for Fire approval;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of
  the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set
  forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere
  to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
   regulations, including noise and signage.Motion carried unanimously (Activity No.
  00407093)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was reported that there
were no public requests to speak.
